headline.caveat: SoftBank bought $2B of Intel common stock at $23/share (Aug 2025), a strategic minority stake (~2%).

nature_md: SoftBank purchased $2B of newly issued Intel common stock at $23/share, announced days before the US government's $8.9B conversion — a coordinated confidence signal in Intel's foundry turnaround from the world's most aggressive AI investor. Passive minority stake; no board seat or offtake attached, though it complements SoftBank's broader US chip footprint (Arm, Ampere, Stargate fabs speculation).

accounting.payer_treatment_md: SoftBank books a marketable equity investment at fair value through earnings (its standard treatment), adding INTC mark-to-market swings to its Vision-Fund-driven P&L volatility.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Intel books $2B of equity issuance — cash and shareholders' equity up; no revenue, no obligation. Slight dilution alongside the government stake.
